 Raylen Wilson says he initially thought the man was a Bulldogs supporter. Share Georgia players celebrate with fans after Georgia defeated Alabama on Oct. 10, 2026, in Tuscaloosa. Georgia won 20-17. (Hyosub Shin/AJC) By Connor Riley Oct 15, 2026 Fan behavior was a big talking point coming out of Saturday’s Georgia-Alabama game. 
 Although some Alabama fans reacted to the loss and officiating by throwing water bottles on the field, one spectator came down from his seat and got in the face of and shoved Georgia linebacker Raylen Wilson. 
 Related Story Georgia claims No. 1 spot in AP Top 25 after win over Alabama The University of Alabama released a statement regarding the interaction on Thursday, stating it had identified the fan in question. 
 “Alabama has identified and taken appropriate action against the individual involved in videos circulating on social media following Saturday night’s football game,” Alabama athletics said in the statement. “We take matters of this nature seriously and will not tolerate this behavior.”
